title: 第15章 江山易改本性难移第16章 叶念念念不忘
slug: 什么梦中的娘子都是真的
content_zh:
【你纵横情场数十年。
【各种各样的女人、仙子、魔头，你深入交流过。
【用阅女无数来形容，丝毫不为过。
【但扪心自问。
【你从未遇见过像李若望如此美丽的女子。
【这一夜后。
【你成功跻身化神境。
【未来的两个月。
【你与李若望如胶似漆，夫妻恩爱无比。
【甚至做到了举案齐眉的地步。
【无数盯着你的大臣们，也都很是疑惑。
【难不成，在女帝的影响下，你真的从良了？】
【日子一点一点过去。
【你那颗心又再次变得不安分起来。
【有句话说的好，江山易改，本性难移。
【在第三个月的时候。
【你找到李若望，有些心虚的表示，有位天门宗的道友准备成亲，你打算去参加婚宴。
【李若望欣然同意。
【你很是开心，立刻前往了天门宗。
【但并不是去参加婚宴。

【而是去寻找新的猎物。
【两天的时间，你与天门宗的一位女长老情投意合。
content_en:
[You have been in love for decades.
[You have had in-depth exchanges with various women, fairies, and demons.
[To describe it as having countless women is not an exaggeration.
[But ask yourself.
【You have never met a woman as beautiful as Li Ruowang.
【After this night.
[You have successfully entered the realm of gods.
[The next two months.
[You and Li Ruowang are inseparable, and your husband and wife are extremely loving.
[Even to the point of raising eyebrows together.
[The countless ministers who are staring at you are also very confused.
[Is it possible that under the influence of the Empress, you have really become a good person? 】
[The days pass by little by little.
[Your heart becomes restless again.
[There is a saying that goes well: a country is easy to change, but a person's nature is hard to change.
[In the third month.
[You find Li Ruowang and express a guilty conscience. A fellow Taoist from the Tianmen Sect is getting married, and you plan to attend the wedding banquet.
[Li Ruowang readily agreed.
[You were very happy and immediately went to Tianmen Sect.
[But I’m not going to the wedding banquet.
[But to find new prey.
[In two days, you fell in love with a female elder of Tianmen Sect.
